description:
I'm Hal Brennan. I framed houses around Kansas City starting in 1976,
then worked as a home inspector from 1985 until I retired. Forty-one
years, about five thousand houses.

Here I tell you what I found in them. Which problems are serious and
which are just cosmetic. What sellers cover up. Which repairs you'll be
talked into and usually don't need. And what you can check on your own
house with an hour and a flashlight.

Most of it comes back to water. It usually does.

I'm not a lawyer, an agent or an engineer. I'm the guy who crawled
under the house.
